key_decisions.decision: Choose quiver for rare teli and game according to the recorded qere tsayid; retain the ketiv and qere in the source binding.
Render nafshi as wholehearted personal blessing rather than a separable soul; keep meal, purpose, and death sequence.
Choose the mocking sense of metatea and retain Jacob’s fear of discovery rather than adding moral remorse.
Keep the direct false identification and firstborn claim; render the repeated nefesh idiom consistently with verse 4.
Restore the explicit nefesh idiom omitted from the prior English here; name the servers and eater without changing the actions.
Preserve gendered brothers/mother’s sons, the command be lord, and the curse/blessing pair; follow the recorded bowing qere.
Keep Esau’s echo of the requested meal and nefesh blessing, using polite direct address for the third-person courtesy form.
Choose pushed me aside for the supplanting wordplay; keep birthright and blessing distinct and the allegation in Esau’s voice.
Retain the separative reading of min provisionally; disclose the consequential alternative in/of the earth’s richness in Notes.
Keep sword, service, and the concrete yoke; retain restless for difficult tarid without claiming a settled historical fulfillment.
Keep the source’s disturbing comforting-himself expression and the unspecified report to Rebekah without inventing an informer.
